segments: the middle of the inhabited world as far as the eastern border:
And to the sons of Ham, then:
the entire south from east to west:
And to the sons of Japheth:
the entire north from east to west:
and the sons of Joktan his brother saw that they had no inheritance,
they set up for themselves three chiefs:
Sheba, and Ophir (or Asir?), and Havilah;
and they seized territories for themselves.
And men began to build towers {OCR?} in order to flee and to hide themselves from the weapons of the sons of Joktan,
for they were the first who began to arm themselves.
And the sons of Canaan, son of Ham, son of Noah,
when they saw that the land of Palestine and of Lebanon was good,
and did not want to go to their inheritance, which was west of the Sea of Egypt.
At the age of one hundred and thirty-three years, [Peleg] {OCR?} begot Reu.
All his life was three hundred and thirty-nine years.
of Reu, began to be built the structure of the Great Tower in the land of Shinar;
and Nimrod son of Cush was feeding the builders with his hunting.
And after forty years, when it was completed,
God sent a wind and the Tower was overthrown;
and in it Nimrod died, the one who, after the Flood, was the first to reign in Babylon.
And his royal crown was woven,
Now that Nimrod built three cities:
that is, Edessa, Nisibis, and Seleucia.
And their speech was divided into seventy-two languages,
and the land of Shinar was called Babel, that is, Confusion.
